context: The Binance hot-wallet incident moved 233.46M XRP from five Binance XRPL wallets to one attacker-controlled account. Independent analytics report the balance unmoved through 2026-10-31 16:51 UTC. Binance separately says XRP customer assets are 100% backed after reserve replenishment. Circle and Ripple froze issuer-controlled stablecoins, but native XRP cannot be frozen.
decisions: Separate Binance customer-asset coverage, replacement acquisitions and recovery of the stolen coins into distinct accounting states.
Do not infer Binance purchased 233.46M XRP. Record XRP-specific purchases, existing reserve inventory, OTC acquisition and internal transfers as separate unknowns until disclosed or observed.

Track the attacker XRP account as a conditional supply-overhang event. Require a new validated ledger, account sequence/balance, outgoing transaction hash and destination classification before recording movement.
Treat a first outgoing attacker-wallet transaction as an alert trigger, not proof of sale. Follow onward payments, bridges, DEX routes and exchange deposits separately.
Keep native XRP non-freezability distinct from issuer controls over USDC, USDT and RLUSD.
Record Circle's CCTP use in the attacker's AVAX-to-USDC-to-Ethereum path as a rail observation, not evidence of Circle's intent or compromise.
Keep FBI's TraderTraitor attribution scoped to the overall Binance incident; the FBI alert's published address list does not name the XRPL attacker address.
Preserve provider-specific theft totals, freeze totals, timestamps and market metrics; do not average incompatible datasets.
Do not admit CoinGecko market values into the feature store without exact quote timestamps, source coverage and point-in-time snapshots.
Do not issue a directional forecast from the incident alone.

feature_gate.attacker_wallet_monitoring: DESIGNED; requires validated public ledger feed
feature_gate.xrp_specific_binance_replenishment: NOT_ADMITTED; quantity and acquisition route unknown
feature_gate.stablecoin_freeze_events: EVENT_CONTEXT_ONLY; not an XRP directional feature by itself
feature_gate.spot_depth_and_volume: INDICATIVE_ONLY; exact quote timestamp and venue methodology require reconciliation
